C. Test records
Test case FAT-S-01
Procedure Product flow at EDI outlet: run the skid on the vendor's test water and read the product flow meter.
Required NLT 2 m³/h
Measured 2.1 m³/h
Verdict PASS
Test case FAT-S-02
Procedure EDI outlet conductivity: read the conductivity at the EDI outlet on the vendor's test water.
Required NMT 1.3 µS/cm
Measured 0.12 µS/cm
Verdict PASS
Test case FAT-S-03
Procedure Review of 3.1 certificates of wetted parts (tank, loop pipework, valves).
Required SS 316L
Measured SS 316L
Verdict PASS
Test case FAT-S-04
Procedure Hot water sanitisation – valve sequence: start the sequence and check that the PLC closes and locks every point-of-use valve.
Required Present and functional
Measured Present and functional
Verdict PASS
Test case FAT-S-05
Procedure Softener outlet hardness: test a sample at the softener outlet (as CaCO₃).
Required ≤ 1 mg/L
Measured 0.4 mg/L
Verdict PASS
